{"query":"SELECT
  SEM_NORM(variety, 'merge spelling variants of the same mango cultivar; keep distinct cultivars separate') AS variety,
  SEM_NORM(place, 'canonical Indian city, town, district, region, or locality; retain district suffix when stated') AS place,
  SEM_NORM(state, 'canonical current Indian state or union territory name') AS state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT url) AS source_mentions,
  ANY_VALUE(relationship) AS relationship,
  ANY_VALUE(url) AS source_url
FROM r24e909e542b
WHERE variety IS NOT NULL
  AND place IS NOT NULL
  AND state IS NOT NULL
  AND SEM_MATCH(
    variety || ' | ' || place || ' | ' || state || ' | ' || COALESCE(relationship, ''),
    'is a plausible named Indian mango cultivar linked to a specific place in the correctly matching Indian state; excludes countries, generic fruit terms, recipes, brands, shops, festivals, people, and malformed text'

  SEM_NORM(variety, 'merge spelling variants of the same mango cultivar; keep distinct cultivars separate'),
  SEM_NORM(place, 'canonical Indian city, town, district, region, or locality; retain district suffix when stated'),
  SEM_NORM(state, 'canonical current Indian state or union territory name')
ORDER BY source_mentions DESC
LIMIT 300","show_preview":false}
